name: Xu Zhou
title: Assistant Professor
bio:
I am an Assistant Professor at Penn State and lead the **Intelligent Food Processing & AI Automation Lab**. Our team integrates **Food Science**, **Engineering**, and **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** to advance next-generation food manufacturing.

Our group develops advanced food processing technologies and computational methods for next-generation food manufacturing systems. Our long-term goal is to enable autonomous, self-driving food engineering laboratories and factories. Currently, we focus on digital twins (sensing, simulation, human–AI collaboration, and robotics) for food processing and supply chains, with the aim of improving food nutrition, quality, safety, and sustainability.

Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Scholar at the [AI Institute for Food Systems](https://aifs.ucdavis.edu/) (UC Davis) and University of Washington. I earned my Ph.D. in Food Engineering (advisor: [Dr. Juming Tang](https://ise.washington.edu/facultyfinder/juming-tang)) and a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
